admission.justification: Realized across explainer_staging.py confinement guards and explainer_server.py refusal translation, proved by test_staging_guards_refuse_symlinks_and_surface_as_refused_publish, preventing symlinked or escaped staging paths from writing or deleting outside the workspace or raising uncaught errors.

applicability: Every directory or file path that explainer publish staging creates, reuses, prunes, or discards within an explainer workspace.
conditions: Staging operates on an explainer workspace root with either workspace-relative or recorded resolved working paths.
exclusions: Non-staging workspace copies such as kit, starters, exemplar, or published revision folders managed by explainer_workspace.
statement: Every path that explainer publish staging creates, reuses, or removes is guarded inside the workspace with guard_path before use without pre-resolving, recorded paths use workspace.resolve() as root, and any PathRefused surfaces through explainer_server as a refused publish with reason path-held rather than an uncaught exception.
title: Explainer publish staging is confined to the workspace and surfaces path-held
